## Changes made

### `src/slugkit/unique.py` (new)
Implements `unique_slug(text, existing)`:
1. Computes `base = slugify(text)` — reuses spec 001's function
2. Returns `base` immediately if not in `existing`
3. Otherwise tries suffixes `~2`, `~3`, … until a free slot is found
4. Trims the base so `len(trimmed_base) + len(suffix) ≤ SLUG_MAX`, then strips any trailing `~` from the cut before appending the suffix

### `src/slugkit/__init__.py` (updated)
Added `unique_slug` to the import and `__all__`.

### `tests/test_unique.py` (new)
Tests covering every spec rule:
- Base not taken → returned as-is
- Base taken → `~2` suffix
- Multiple suffixes taken → increments
- `existing` is never modified
- `EMPTY_SLUG` base path (`n~a~2`, etc.)
- Result always ≤ `SLUG_MAX` characters
- No trailing `~` on the trimmed base before the suffix
- Separator at cut point handled correctly
- Large `n` values (up to 102)
- Suffix separator matches the `SEPARATOR` constant","time":{"start":1794710789054,"end":1794710795586}}}
